description: chat.rs and identity.rs update loops use args.get("update").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) which borrows args, requiring patch_val.clone() on every update call (chat.rs:454, identity.rs:250). mailbox.rs correctly uses args.remove("update") to take ownership and then into_iter() to consume without cloning. The chat.rs and identity.rs update paths missed this fix from JMAP-4ii.26. Fix: use the same args.remove("update") pattern so patches can be passed by value without cloning.
title: chat.rs/identity.rs update loop: args.get borrows update map, forces patch_val.clone()
